title: Grimdark Magazine Issue #34
author: Christopher Ruocchio, Ken Scholes, Guy Haley, Miles Cameron, Beth Tabler, and Sarah Chorn

highlights.text: “Hadrian Marlowe is no friend. He is an atomic bomb; one wrong move and he will explode in all our faces.
“Who do you think you are?” asked Yazdan. “Do you know who I am?” “That’s not something an innocent man would say,”
You think you are a dangerous man. A careful man. But you’re not. Not really. Not careful enough to recognize when you are up against a man far more dangerous than you.”
